blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Language model agents increasingly automate post-training, but when given the full training stack they converge on supervised fine-tuning and spend most effort revising training data. Existing systems give the agent one kind of control, selecting rows from a fixed pool or calling a generator, whereas a human data engineer adjusts proportions, prunes, repairs, replaces and synthesizes the data. We design a data action space for these changes and ask whether an automated system can make the full range rather than one of them, and what structure that requires. We first run this loop with a single agent, and it reaches only one action, adjusting category proportions, while its context fills with execution output and is discarded mid-search. We therefore introduce \textbf{AutoSFT}, a multi-agent system where a meta agent separates execution from analysis, gathers proposals from independent angles, and calls a synthesis subagent for capabilities the pool cannot cover, with the model, the trainer, and the budget fixed within each comparison. Adding each component in turn helps: the executor halves context loss, the analysis subagents lift the best IFEval by $+6.5$, and synthesis adds $+3.4$ IFEval and $+2.9$ IFBench. The same loop transfers to code, where analysis adds $+3.7$ MBPP+ over a single agent that does not improve. Every result comes from runs that retrain from the base model each round, so each component's effect is individually attributable. Our findings suggest that automating SFT data research depends more on covering diverse data actions than on a stronger single action.
blocks.zh: 语文模型代理人越来越多地使培训后自动化,但如果有了完整的培训堆,他们就集中到有监督的微调上,花费了大部分精力来修订培训数据。 现有系统给予代理一种控制,从固定的池中选择行或呼叫发电机,而人类数据工程师则会调整比例,棱镜,修复,替换并合成数据. 我们为这些变化设计了一个数据行动空间,并询问一个自动化系统是否能够使整个范围而不是其中一个范围,需要什么样的结构. 我们先用单个代理来运行这个循环,它只达到一个动作,调整类别比例,而其上下文充满了执行输出,被丢弃了中搜索. 因此,我们引入了\textbf{AutoSFT},这是一个多代理系统,一个元代理将执行与分析分开,从独立角度收集建议,并称为集合无法覆盖能力的合成子代理,模型,教练器,以及预算在每次比较中固定. 添加每个元件反过来有助于:执行器将上下文损失减半,分析子剂将最好的IFEval提升6.5美元,而合成则增加3.4美元IFEval和2.9美元IF Bench. 同样的循环传输到代码中,分析会比一个没有改进的单一剂增加3.7美元+MBPP+. 每个结果都来自每回合从基模型中再排出分量的跑道,所以每个组件的效果都是个别可归属的. 我们的调查结果表明,SFT数据研究的自动化更多地取决于涵盖各种数据行动,而不是更强有力的单一行动。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
LLM agents now run long workflows with little human oversight, and several systems use them to automate parts of AI research itself [ Lu et al., 2026 , Tang et al., 2025 , Hu et al., 2025 , Wen et al., 2026 ] .
What makes such a loop searchable is that every proposal can be evaluated automatically, and post-training has this property, so recent benchmarks evaluate agents on it [ Rank et al., 2026 , Chen et al., 2026a ] .
Given control of the whole training stack, agents converge on one part: across the runs audited by PostTrainBench [ Rank et al., 2026 ] , they adopt supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and spend most of their remaining effort revising the training data.
This agrees with a broader finding that a carefully curated dataset can match or outperform a much larger one [ Zhou et al., 2023a , Chen et al., 2024 , Muennighoff et al., 2025 ] , and that data selection and arrangement affect downstream performance directly [ He et al., 2025a , Agarwal et al., 2025 ] .
Recent systems therefore treat the data as the main search object [ Wu et al., 2026 , Luo et al., 2026 , Zhao et al., 2026 , Kulikov et al., 2026 ] .
blocks.zh:
LLM代理目前运行长的工作流程,几乎没有人监督,有多个系统利用它们将AI研究本身的部分自动化[Lu等,2026年;Tang等,2025年;Hu等,2025年;Wen等,2026年].
这使得这样一个循环搜索是每个建议都可以自动评价,而后培训有这种属性,因此最近的基准评价了上面的代理人[Rank等,2026年,Chen等,2026年a].
由于对整个训练堆的控制,特工们集中了一部分:在PostTrain Bench [Rank等人,2026年]审计的全行中,他们采用了有监督的微调(SFT),并花费了剩下的大部分精力来修订训练数据.
这与更广泛的结论一致,即仔细整理的数据集可以匹配或超越更大的数据集[周等,2023年a;陈等,2024年;穆能尼格罗夫等,2025年],数据选择和安排直接影响下游绩效[. He等,2025a;Agarwal等,2025]).
因此,最近的系统将数据作为主要搜索对象[Wu等,2026年;Luo等,2026年;赵等,2026年;Kulikov等,2026年]].

blocks.en:
Each existing system gives the agent a single kind of control, selecting rows from a fixed pool or calling a generator.
We ask whether an automated agent can instead command the full space of operations that an experienced data engineer uses. Such an engineer adjusts category proportions, prunes and repairs rows, replaces overlong responses, writes examples for missing capabilities, and orders the data.
We write these six kinds of change as a data action space ( Section 2 ), and use it only after a run to measure how much of that space the agent reaches.

每个已存在的系统都给予特效一种控制,从固定池中选择行或调用生成器.
我们问一个自动代理机是否能够指挥一个经验丰富的数据工程师使用的全部操作空间. 这样的工程师会调整类别比例,穿行和修行,替换过长的响应,为缺失的能力写出实例,并命令数据.
我们把这六种变化写成一个数据动作空间(第2节), 并且只有在运行后使用它来测量这个代理到达的空间的多少。

blocks.en:
We first study this question with a single agent, restarting each round from the same base checkpoint.
The agent collapses onto one action family, repeats related recipes, and spends most of its context on raw command output rather than data analysis. Section 3 examines these failures, the trace evidence, and our fix, explaining why an undivided research loop is hard to sustain.
One agent analyzes behavior, proposes data changes, executes experiments, and interprets logs, so execution competes with analysis for context and a single proposal stream reinforces recent choices.
This yields two requirements: isolate execution from data analysis, and maintain complementary views of the same model behavior during proposal generation.
blocks.zh:
我们首先用一个单一的代理人来研究这个问题,从同一个基地检查站重新开始每一回合.
代理崩溃到一个动作家族,重复相关的食谱,并将其大部分上下文用于原始指令输出而不是数据分析. 第3节审查了这些失败, 追踪证据, 和我们的固定, 解释为什么一个不可分割的研究循环 很难维持。
一个代理分析行为,提出数据更改,执行实验,并解释日志,因此执行与上下文分析相竞争,单一的建议书流强化了最近的选择.
这产生了两个要求:将执行与数据分析隔离开来,并在提案生成过程中保持对同一种模型行为的互补观点.

Analysis subagents read these artifacts from complementary angles, and a synthesis subagent writes data for undersupplied capabilities. The meta agent integrates their proposals into the next recipe. All roles share a candidate data pool and a skill library.

blocks.en:
AutoSFT ( Section 4 ) is a multi-agent system built around these two requirements.
A meta agent owns each round and delegates to three kinds of subagent.
An executor runs training, conversion, and evaluation separately, returning file paths and a short status report so the meta agent can spend its context on data.
Analysis subagents read the same round from four angles: training data, failures, training signals, and earlier rounds, each returning one proposed data action.
A synthesis subagent writes new data for capabilities the pool barely covers, which neither of the first two can add.

每轮拥有一元代理,代表作有三种副代理.
一个执行器分别运行训练,转换,以及评价,返回文件路径和一份简短的状态报告,这样元代理可以将其上下文花在数据上.

blocks.en:
We add the three components one at a time, fixing the base model, initial pool, token budget, training script, and evaluation within each comparison, so any difference is attributable to the added component ( Section 5 ).
The executor halves context loss, the analysis subagents broaden the range of changes and raise best IFEval by + 6.5 +6.5 , and synthesis adds + 3.4 +3.4 IFEval and + 2.9 +2.9 IFBench by covering undersupplied capabilities.
The same loop transfers to code domain without a ready-made capability taxonomy, adding + 3.7 +3.7 MBPP+ over a single agent that does not improve ( Section 5.4 ).
Together, these results suggest that automating SFT data research depends less on a stronger single action than on structure that lets an agent cover the range of changes a data engineer makes.

blocks.en: Contributions. Our contributions are threefold. • We frame automated SFT data research around a space of six data-engineering actions, and show that a corrected single-agent loop reaches only one of them ( Sections 2 and 3 ). • We build AutoSFT , a multi-agent system that isolates execution, gathers proposals from complementary analysis angles, and synthesizes data for capabilities the pool lacks ( Section 4 ). • Adding each component while retraining from the base model, so its effect is attributable, widens the actions a run takes and improves the recipe, by + 6.5 +6.5 IFEval from analysis, + 3.4 +3.4 IFEval and + 2.9 +2.9 IFBench from synthesis, and + 3.7 +3.7 MBPP+ in a code domain ( Section 5 ).

blocks.en: 2.2 Data research actions
blocks.zh: 2.2 国家 数据研究行动

blocks.en:
A recipe is built out of rows, where a row carries an instruction, a response, and the metadata that describes it.
An action states which rows to train on, how often each appears, in what order, and whether any row is edited or newly written.
Agents write recipes in free form with no field schema, operator list, and statement that a particular kind of change is available.
blocks.zh:

动作说明要训练的行, 每一行的出现频率, 顺序, 以及任何行是编辑的还是新写的 。
代理以免费的形式写出食谱,没有字段计划,操作员列表,并声明有特定类型的变化.

blocks.en:
Figure 3 describes the six families of data action a data researcher makes most often.
Each family is fixed by what happens to the rows and by the level at which the change is decided, which ranges from a whole category through a single row and a capability to the recipe as a whole, so an action can be labelled from the recipe diff without reading the agent’s stated reason.

每个家庭都由行发生的事情和决定变化的级别来决定,这些变化从整个类别到一行,从能力到整个食谱,所以一个动作可以从食谱diff中标出,而无需读取代理商说明的理由.

We apply the labels only after a run and report how many families a run covered alongside its scores.

blocks.en: 3 Pilot study: What limits single agents in SFT data research
blocks.zh: 3个 试点研究: 何以限制SFT数据研究中的单一代理

blocks.en:
We study how a single agent behaves when it owns an entire SFT data research loop.
We reproduce the open-ended PostTrainBench setting [ Rank et al., 2026 ] for Qwen3-1.7B-Base [ Yang et al., 2025 ] on IFEval [ Zhou et al., 2023b ] , in which the agent receives one H100, unrestricted internet access, and a ten-hour wall-clock budget.
Six design choices in this setting interfere with measuring what the agent does with data, and we correct them before running the loop: we fix the training algorithm to SFT, provide an initial dataset pool instead of Internet search, add a second benchmark IFBench [ Pyatkin et al., 2025 ] , retrain from the base checkpoint each round, replace the wall-clock allowance with benchmark targets, and return richer feedback including training loss, category-level scores, and per-example failures.
Details are deferred to Appendix A .

blocks.en: 3.1 Three failure modes of the single-agent loop
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 单代理循环的三个失败模式

Each round draws a recipe of at most 10M tokens and trains for three epochs at sequence length 32,768, with global batch size 16 and learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} .

在中等推理努力中,一个运行GPT-5.5的单一Codex代理提交了33发子弹,并在11.5小时内完成了对其中32发子弹的评价,这时两个目标都没有达到.

blocks.zh: 图4 : 左: 单轴上32个评估回合的基准分数. Right : 代理用于描述其所选数据动作的术语,大小按其使用次数计算.

blocks.en:
The search stays inside one family of actions. Every round adjusts how much of each category to train on, so the whole run falls in the mixture family.
As Figure 4 shows, round 9 is the best on both benchmarks and the 23 rounds after it produce nothing better.
The agent does not lack terms for the move it repeats, using 22 distinct expressions across the run, from reweight to raise and concentrate .
What it lacks is variety in the move itself.
Its reasoning never mentions repairing a row, replacing a response, or writing a new example, and the corresponding terms do not appear in the trace.
blocks.zh:
搜查只停留在一个行动家族中。 每轮调整每个类别中需要训练多少,所以整个跑步都落在了混合家族中.
如图4所示,第9轮在两个基准上都是最佳的,其后的23轮没有任何好结果。
该剂不缺乏其重复移动的条件,使用22个不同的表达方式,从再重到起重和集中。
它缺乏的是运动本身的多样性。
它的推理从未提及修补一行,取代了回应,或者写出新的例子,相应的术语不出现在痕迹中.

blocks.zh: 图5:按时数计的预算每轮培训数据。

blocks.en:
Time Limits Reduce Per-Round Training Data. The open-ended run is allotted ten hours, and Figure 5 reports the amount of data presented to the trainer in each round.
The recipe expands over the first four rounds, reaching 264k rows, and then declines in every subsequent round, ending at 69k rows, which is 26% of the peak.
The agent continues to submit rounds throughout, so the run does not terminate early.
Rather, it progressively reduces the cost of each remaining round.
Once a checkpoint is sufficiently good to retain, additional training data yields no further improvement under the objective, whereas the time it would cost can be used for another attempt.
Under benchmark targets, this contraction does not occur: recipe size is around max token budget, and the agent never refers to the remaining time budget.
blocks.zh:
限时减少每轮训练数据。 图5报告了每轮向培训员提供的数据数量。
食谱在前四轮展开,达到264k行,后每轮下降,以69k行结束,为高峰的26%.
毒剂在整个过程中不断提交弹出,因此跑道不会提前终止.
相反,这逐步减少了每轮剩余工作的费用。
一旦检查站足以保留,额外培训数据将不会在目标下得到进一步改善,而费用可以用于另一次尝试。
在基准目标下,这种收缩不会发生:食谱大小在最大象征性预算左右,代理商从不提及所剩时间预算.

blocks.en:
The context fills and is discarded ten times. The agent runs data decisions, job submission, checkpoint conversion, and evaluation in one session, and Figure 6 shows that session filling to 94.7% of a 258,400-token window and being compacted ten times, first during round 2 and then every three to four rounds.
Research history is therefore discarded and rebuilt ten times while the search is still running.
The context is not dominated by the obvious suspect.
Polling job status is the most frequent operation, at 371 calls, yet it accounts for only 1.7% of the 9.9M bytes accumulated.
The space goes instead to a few large payloads: training output at 13.4%, repeated reads of the run record at 11.8%, applying the data action at 9.7%, and evaluation output at 8.9%. With the agent’s reasoning (16.3%) and compaction summaries (8.3%), six sources take two thirds of the window.
None of them relates to choosing the next data action, which argues for giving those steps their own session.
blocks.zh:
上下文填充并被丢弃了十回. 该代理在一个会话中进行数据决策、工作提交、检查站转换和评价,图6显示该会话填补了258 400个窗口的94.7%,并被压缩了10次,首先是第2轮,然后每三至四轮。
因此,研究历史被抛弃并被重建了十次,而搜索仍在进行。
其背景并非由明显的嫌疑人所支配.
投票工作状况是最常见的操作,在371个电话中,但只占所累积的9.9M字节的1.7%。
空间改为几个大型有效载荷:培训产出为13.4%,重复读取运行记录为11.8%,应用数据动作为9.7%,评价产出为8.9%。 由于代理商的推理(16.3%)和收缩摘要(8.3%),6个来源占了窗口的三分之二.

blocks.en: 3.2 From observations to requirements
blocks.zh: 3.2 从意见到所需经费

blocks.en:
The second observation is answered by the objective itself, and the controlled loop already carries that change.
The other two set the structure AutoSFT has to provide.
Execution has to leave the deciding agent’s context, so a dedicated executor runs submission, conversion, and evaluation in its own session and returns status receipts and artifact paths ( Section 4.1 ).
Proposals have to come from multiple lines of reasoning, so we run several analysis subagents from different angles, following Wen et al. [2026] , who find that distinct starting directions preserve diversity across parallel agents ( Section 4.2 ).
Besides, neither change introduces data that the pool did not already contain, which is a separate limitation and the reason Section 4.3 introduces a third component.
blocks.zh:
第二项观察是由目标本身回答的,被控制的循环已经伴随着这个变化.
另外两个设定了AutoSFT必须提供的结构.
执行必须离开决定代理人的背景,所以一个专门的执行者在自己的会话中进行提交、转换和评价,并返回状况收据和文物路径(第4.1节)。
提案必须来自多条推理线,因此我们从不同角度运行了几种分析子剂,跟随了文等. [2026],他们发现不同的起步方向保持了平行代理人的多样性(第4.2节.
此外,这两个变化都引入了池中尚未包含的数据,这是一个单独的限制,第4.3节引入了第三个组成部分。

blocks.en: 4 AutoSFT
blocks.zh: 4 自动SFT

blocks.en:
AutoSFT instantiates the research policy π \pi of Section 2.1 and shares M 0 M_{0} , D 0 D_{0} , and the training and evaluation protocol with the single agent of Section 3 .
A meta agent owns the round and delegates to three kinds of subagents: an executor subagent , four analysis subagents , and a synthesis subagent , whose information flow is shown in Figure 1 .
The meta agent hands D t D_{t} and R t R_{t} to the executor, which trains and evaluates in a separate session and returns the feedback F t F_{t} .
The analysis and synthesis subagents then consult the relevant parts of D t D_{t} , R t R_{t} , F t F_{t} , and H < t H_{<t} through their associated files. Each analysis subagent proposes a change to the recipe from its own perspective, while the synthesis subagent generates data for undersupplied capability targets to form D t + 1 D_{t+1} .
The meta agent weighs these proposals against its own reading and settles on a t a_{t} , giving R t + 1 = a t ​ ( D t + 1 , R t ) R_{t+1}=a_{t}(D_{t+1},R_{t}) . Implementation details, including a skill library and memory design, are given in Appendix B .

blocks.en: 4.1 Executor subagent
blocks.zh: 4.1 执行子代理人

blocks.en:
As shown in Section 3.1 , the context of the single-agent loop fills with the verbose logs and outputs of training and evaluation jobs, leaving the information that matters unused.
Given this, we introduce an executor, which takes the entire lifecycle of training, checkpoint conversion, and evaluation out of the meta agent and maintains a context of its own.
Specifically, everything it does is one cycle of submitting a job, monitoring it to completion, and collecting its artifacts : the cycle runs once on the training job to obtain the round’s model C t C_{t} , and then once on each of the K K benchmarks to obtain the evaluation results for C t C_{t} , with the raw logs and intermediate outputs staying in its own context.
When the workflow finishes, the executor saves the feedback artifacts and a structured execution report to files and returns only their paths. The meta agent and the analysis and synthesis subagents can then read the relevant
files as needed, without receiving the full execution logs.
blocks.zh:
如第3.1节所示,单一代理环的上下文充满了培训和评价工作的动词记录和产出,使重要信息未使用。
有鉴于此,我们引入了一个执行者,它将训练、检查站转换和评价的整个生命周期从元代理人中抽出,并保持其自身的背景。
具体来说,它所做的一切都是一个周期,即提交工作、监测工作完成情况并收集其文物: 周期一度在培训工作上运行,以获得该回合的Ct C_{t}模式,然后在K基准上运行一次,以获得Ct C_{t}的评价结果,原始的日志和中间产出仍保留在自己的背景中。
当工作流程完成后,执行者将反馈文物和结构化的执行报告保存到文件并只返回其路径. 元剂以及分析和合成子剂可以读取相关的
文档,无需完整执行日志。

blocks.en: 4.2 Analysis subagents
blocks.zh: 4.2 分析子剂

blocks.en:
Section 3.1 shows that all 33 rounds of the single agent stay inside the mixture family: it pursues the objective through one kind of strategy.
To break out of the limitation, we introduce four analysis agents, each of which examines the current round from a different evidence source: the training data, failure cases, learning dynamics, or research history.
blocks.zh:
第3.1节显示,所有33发单剂都停留在混合物家族内:它通过一种策略追求目标.
为了打破限制,我们引入了四个分析剂,每个分析剂都从不同的证据来源来审查本轮:培训数据,失败案例,学习动力学,或研究历史.

blocks.en:
The four subagents examine each round using complementary evidence. The training-data subagent reads D t D_{t} and R t R_{t} , assesses the selected data for quality, difficulty, coverage, and redundancy, and proposes changes to its content or composition under the fixed token budget. The failure-case subagent compares successful and failed cases in F t F_{t} to identify recurring failure patterns and propose supervision to address them. The learning-dynamics subagent analyzes the training loss and other monitoring signals in F t F_{t} in relation to the data used for training, seeking evidence that explains stalled learning progress. The history subagent reads H < t H_{<t} , distinguishes failed interventions from ideas that have not been adequately tested, and proposes corrections or renewed trials.
Each subagent returns one executable data proposal with supporting evidence.
blocks.zh:
4名副剂利用补充证据对每轮检查. 培训数据子代理读取了Dt D_{t}和Rt R_{t},评估选定的数据的质量、难度、覆盖面和冗余程度,并在固定符号预算下建议修改其内容或组成。 故障子代理比较了Ft F_{t}t}中的成功和失败案例,以识别反复发生的故障模式并提议监督处理. 学习动力学子剂结合培训所用数据分析Ft F_{t}中的训练损失和其他监测信号,并寻找证据来解释学习进展停滞的原因. 历史副代理人读取了H < t H_{<t},将失败的干预与没有经过充分检验的想法区分开来,并提出了改正或重新审判.
每个子代理返回一个可执行数据提案并附有支持证据.

blocks.en: 4.3 Synthesis subagent
blocks.zh: 4.3 合成亚剂

blocks.en:
In practice, the initial pool D 0 D_{0} may not cover every capability the benchmarks require, and for others it holds examples but too few to constitute effective supervision.
We therefore introduce a synthesis subagent to generate examples for undersupplied capability targets.
Such a target is convenient to state and to verify in the instruction-following setting: it is a single checkable constraint, or a combination of constraints that co-occur, such as repeating the instruction verbatim while using no comma , and in either case a programmatic verifier decides whether an example satisfies it.
blocks.zh:
在实践中,初始人才库D 0 D_{0}可能无法涵盖基准要求的每一项能力,而对于其他人才而言,它仅举出一些例子,但太少,无法构成有效的监督。
因此,我们引进了合成子剂,以产生供应不足能力目标的例子。
这种目标便于在遵循指令的设置中说明和核实:这是一个单一的可核对约束,或者是共同存在的制约的组合,如在不使用逗号的情况下逐字重复指令,在这两种情况下,由程序核查人决定一个实例是否满足。

blocks.en:
Concretely, the synthesis agent is invoked in every round, reads the evaluation results, and derives a set of targets to strengthen.
For each target whose supply in D t D_{t} is insufficient, it synthesizes examples that pass the target’s verifier.
If no target is undersupplied in a given round, the synthesis agent generates no data.
Generated data pass verification of the target’s constraint, an independent semantic review, and an n n -gram overlap check against the evaluation sets, described in Appendix B.4 .
Those that pass enter D t + 1 D_{t+1} , and whether the round trains on them remains the meta agent’s decision.
blocks.zh:
具体而言,每轮都使用合成剂,阅读评价结果,并制订一套加强的目标。
对于Dt D_{t}中供应不足的每个目标,它综合了通过目标验证器的例子.
如果某一回合没有向目标提供不足,则合成剂不会生成任何数据。
如附录B.4所述,生成的数据通过对目标约束的核查、独立的语义审查和与评价组合的n-克重叠核对。
那些通过的人进入了Dt + 1 D_{t+1},他们身上的圆形列车是否仍然是元代理人的决定.

blocks.en: 5 Experiment
blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en:
AutoSFT adds three components to the loop of Section 3 , and we test them one at a time.
Each subsection compares a base configuration against the same configuration with one component added, so a difference is attributable to that component alone, while Section 5.4 runs the full system on a coding domain to test whether the same structure transfers.
Appendix D gives the full implementation settings for every comparison and an estimate of the compute and API cost of a run.
blocks.zh:
AutoSFT在第3节循环中增加了三个组件,我们一次测试一次.
每个分节将一个基础配置与同一个配置进行比较,并增加了一个组件,因此一个差异可归因于该组件本身,而第5.4节运行一个编码域上的完整系统以测试同一结构是否转移.
附 录 D给出了每次比较的完整执行设置,并估算了运行的计算和API成本.

blocks.en: 5.1 Executor subagent
blocks.zh: 5.1 执行子剂

blocks.en:
Setup. The base configuration is the single agent of Section 3.1 .
Adding the executor places that lifecycle in a separate session, so the meta agent receives artifact paths and a brief status report rather than executing the lifecycle.
Both runs begin from the same base checkpoint, share the same context window, and are evaluated from snapshots taken at 11.5 hours.
All other settings are identical.
blocks.zh:
设相. 基础配置是第3.1节的单一代理.
添加执行器会将寿命周期放置在单独的会话中,因此元代理接收到文物路径和简要状态报告,而不是执行寿命周期.
两起运行都从同一个基地检查站开始,共用同一上下文窗口,并从11时5分拍摄的快照中进行评估。
所有其他设置都相同 。

blocks.en: Figure 7 : Context used by the meta agent over each run and the composition of its recorded events.
blocks.zh: 图7:元代理在每次运行时所使用的上下文及其记录事件的构成。

blocks.en:
Result. The executor halves how often the meta agent loses its context.
Over comparable elapsed time the base run compacts ten times and the executor run five ( Figure 7 ).
The composition of the meta agent’s work shows where the pressure was coming from.
Shell commands fall from 58% of its recorded events to 29%, and a third of what remains is delegation to the executor.
Status checks are the clearest instance of the material that leaves.
The base agent issues 268 of them and spends 23.0% of its commands asking whether a job has completed.
The base run rebuilds a context dominated by command output, whereas the executor run rebuilds a context containing the round’s analysis.
blocks.zh:
结果。 执行器将元代理人失去上下文的频率减半.
在可比时间里,基地运行了10次,执行者运行了5次(图7)。
元剂的工作组成表明压力来自何处。
壳牌公司的命令从所记录事件的58%下降到29%,剩下的三分之一是委托给执行人.
状况检查是留下材料的最明显的例子。
基地特工发放了268份,花费了23.0%的命令,询问工作是否已经完成。
基础运行重建以命令输出为主的上下文,而执行者运行重建包含回合分析的上下文.

blocks.en: 5.2 Analysis subagent
blocks.zh: 5.2 分析子剂

blocks.en:
Setup. The base configuration uses one agent to read each round’s artifacts and write the next recipe.
The analysis configuration adds four subagents that read the same round from training data, failed outputs, training signals, and earlier rounds, each proposing one change.
A meta agent makes the final decision. Both configurations use the dataset in Section 3.1 , start from the same base checkpoint, train for three epochs under a 3M-token cap, and are evaluated on IFEval using avg@10, per-comparison settings are given in Appendix D .
Neither reached the target.
We therefore report the base setting over 50 rounds and the analysis setting over 30 rounds under the same time budget.
blocks.zh:
设相. 基础配置使用一个代理来读取每一回合的文物并写出下一张食谱.
分析配置新增了从训练数据读取同一回合的4个子剂,失败输出,训练信号,以及更早的回合,每个子剂都提出一个修改.
由元代理人做出最终决定. 两种配置都使用第3.1节中的数据集,从同个基站检查站起发,3M-token盖下为3个世纪的列车,并使用avg@10在IFEval上评价,每个比较设置在附录D中给出.
也没有达到目标。
因此,我们报告50多轮的基数,以及30多轮的分析。

blocks.en: Figure 8 : Left : IFEval per round, with dotted guides at the rounds named in the text. Right : distribution of data actions over Figure 3 in agent traces for w/ and w/o Analysis settings.
blocks.zh: 图8 :左:每轮IFEval,在正文所命名的回合有被点入的向导. 右 : 在 W/ 和 w/ o 分析设置中的代理跟踪图3 上的数据动作分布 。

blocks.en:
Result. Analysis improves the score and reaches higher values earlier.
As shown in Figure 8 , the analysis run reaches 63.33 at R6, already above the best score the base run attains in 50 rounds, and climbs to 67.10 at R30.
The base run’s best is 60.60 within the first 30 rounds and 62.35 across all 50, so analysis leads by 6.50 points at equal rounds and by 4.75 even when the base run is given 20 rounds more.
The two runs also use the data-action families in different proportions ( Figure 8 , right).
With analysis, repair and resupervision together account for 55% of the actions taken, whereas the base run stays within the mixture family, adjusting category proportions in every round as the single agent of Section 3.1 does.
Neither run writes a new example, which is the subject of Section 5.3 , and neither alters the training order because SFT fixes to a shuffling seed.
blocks.zh:
结果。 分析可以提高分数,更早达到更高的值.
如图8所显示的,分析结果在R6时达到63.33分,已经超过50轮的基数得分,在R30时达到67.10分。
基跑的最好成绩是前30轮的60.60分和所有50轮的62.35分,因此,即使基跑多得到20轮,分析仍以6.50分和4.75分领先。
两者还使用不同比例的数据行动家族(图8,右)。
分析、维修和再监督共占所采取行动的55%,而基数运行仍停留在混合家族内部,每轮调整类别比例,如第3.1节的单一剂剂。
运行中都没有写出一个新例子,这是第5.3节的主题,也没有改变训练命令,因为SFT会修正为打发种子.

blocks.en:
Furthermore, the actions that analysis unlocks often set a new best score, where a new best denotes a recipe that exceeds every earlier score in the same run.
Selecting data by validation results sets a new best in 41.7% of its uses, and editing both instructions and answers in 6 of its 14 uses.
The base run never takes these actions, since it stays within the mixture family, so Table 4 in Appendix C.1 reports its new-best rate only for mixture.
In summary, analysis helps the meta agent read the same evidence in multiple ways, so it can better decide which supervision to change and whether the resulting examples teach the intended behavior.
blocks.zh:
此外,分析解锁的动作往往设定出新的最佳分数,其中新的最佳分数表示的食谱超过同一跑道中较早的分数.
通过验证结果选择数据,在其41.7%的用途中设置了新的最佳数据,并在14个用途中的6个用途中编辑指令和答案。
基数运行从不采取这些行动,因为基数停留在混合物家族内,因此附录C.1表4只报告混合物的新最佳率。
简而言之,分析帮助元剂以多种方式读取相同的证据,这样它就可以更好地决定要改变的监管,以及由此产生的例子是否教给预期的行为.

blocks.en: 5.3 Synthesis subagent
blocks.zh: 5.3 合成亚剂

blocks.en:
Setup. The base configuration selects from the staged pool and may edit the examples it selects.
Adding the synthesis subagent enables a round to generate new examples for a capability, written against that capability’s verifier and admitted to the pool only after passing that verifier.
Both runs train from the same base checkpoint for three epochs under a 100M-token cap that counts generated rows, and every checkpoint is evaluated as avg@10 on IFEval and IFBench.
The budget is larger than in the previous two comparisons because a smaller budget would keep the pool below its size cap, whereas new data becomes valuable only once selection can no longer improve the recipe.
blocks.zh:
设相. 基础配置从已上演的池中选择,并可能编辑它所选择的例子.
添加合成子剂可使一回合生成能力的新实例,写在能力的核查人身上,并在通过该核查人之后才被输入池中。
两人从同一个基地检查站开行列车,在100M-token盖下运行3个世纪,计算产生行数,每个检查站在IFEval和IF Bench上被评价为avg@10.
预算比前两次比较要多,因为较小的预算将使现金池低于其规模上限,而新数据只有在选择无法再改进配方时才具有价值。

blocks.en: Figure 9 : Scores per round. Left two panels : synthesis ablation on instruction following (Base vs Base + Synthesis, Section 5.3 ). Right panel : three configurations on code generation ( Section 5.4 ). Bands give the standard deviation over evaluation repeats.
blocks.zh: 图9:每轮得分。 留下两个面板:对以下指示的合成(Base vs Base + Syndrome, 第5.3节)。 右面板:代码生成上的三个配置(第5.4节). 乐队给予标准偏差而不是重复评价.

blocks.en:
Result. Synthesis improves both benchmarks and reaches higher levels earlier.
As shown in Figure 9 (left, middle), the synthesis run reaches a best IFEval of 81.58, compared with 78.15 for the base run, and a best IFBench of 51.95, compared with 49.02.
Every IFEval checkpoint from R9 onward exceeds the best checkpoint that the base run attains over 31 rounds.
The aggregate gain does not imply that every generated batch helps.
The repeat_prompt capability remains near 40% for the first 8 rounds, and the batch supplied at R9 raises it to 75.6% in the same round, showing a weakness the loop diagnoses and then addresses by generating new data.
By contrast, odd_even_syllables is targeted in 3 separate rounds and scores zero in every round, suggesting that supply alone cannot teach a constraint the model cannot yet follow.
In Appendix C.2 , we trace the full run of these capabilities, and conduct a comprehensive per-capability comparison across all targets, showing that most capabilities ending higher with synthesis, with the largest gains on repetition, sentence and word counts, and comma avoidance.
blocks.zh:
结果。 综合既能改进基准,又能提前达到更高的水平。
如图9(左,中)所示,综合运行达到最佳IFEval为81.58,而基跑为78.15;最佳IF Bench为51.95,而最佳IF Bench为49.02.
从R9起,每个IFEval检查站都超过了基地运行超过31发的最佳检查站。
总收益并不意味着每个生成的批次都有帮助。
前8轮的重复_即时能力仍然接近40%,R9提供的批量在同一轮中将其提升到75.6%,表明循环诊断的弱点,然后通过生成新数据进行处理.
相形之下,奇偶_even_sillables在3个相隔的回合中被瞄准,每回合的分数为0,这表明单靠供应无法教给模型尚无法遵循的制约.
在附录C.2中,我们追踪所有这些能力的全部情况,并对所有目标进行全面的人均能力比较,显示大多数能力以合成的方式结束,在重复、句子和字数以及避免逗号方面收益最大。

blocks.en: 5.4 Generalization to code domain
blocks.zh: 5.4 一般化为代码域

blocks.en:
Setup. To assess whether AutoSFT remains effective beyond instruction following, we evaluate it on code generation with MBPP+ 2 2 2 https://huggingface.co/datasets/evalplus/mbppplus .
Unlike IFEval and IFBench, MBPP+ grades only by test execution and carries no capability breakdown, so the system builds its own capability structure from only the benchmark and the pool.
The backbone is Qwen3-1.7B-Base with MBPP+ target score 70, and the pool holds 742,842 Python instruction–code pairs from OPC-SFT-Stage2 [ Huang et al., 2025 ] , KodCode-v1-SFT-R1 [ Xu et al., 2025 ] , and Magicoder-OSS-Instruct-75K [ Wei et al., 2024 ] .
Each round retrains from the backbone for three epochs at sequence length 8,192 under a 100M-token budget and is evaluated using avg@3.
We compare these three configurations: Base, Base + Analysis, and Base + Analysis + Synthesis.
blocks.zh:
设相. 为了评估AutoSFT是否继续有效,我们用MBPP+2 2 2 https://huggingface.co/datasets/evalplus/mbppplus对代码生成进行评估。 。 。 。 。
与IFEval和IF Bench不同,MBPP+的分级只能通过测试执行,不带能力分解,因此系统只从基准和池来建立自己的能力结构.
骨干为有MBPP+目标分数70的Qwen3-1.7B-Base,游泳池持有OPC-SFT-Stage2[黄等,2025],KodCode-v1-SFT-R1[徐等,2025],和Magicoder-OSS-Instruct-75K[Wei等,2024]的742,842 Python 指令-代码对.
在100M-token预算下,每个回合从主干线绕出3个历段,序列长度为8,192个,使用avg@3进行评估。
我们比较这三种配置: 基地 基础+分析,和基础+分析+综合.

blocks.en:
Result. Within 64 hours, Base and Base + Analysis each complete 15 rounds and Base + Analysis + Synthesis completes 6 ( Figure 9 , right panel).
The single agent shows no sustained improvement, while Base + Analysis produces a consistent upward trend and reaches 64.8% at round 13.
Adding synthesis incurs additional runtime per round but reaches 65.8% by round 6.
The structure that helped in instruction following transfers to code: multi-agent analysis lifts the recipe above the single agent, and synthesis reaches a comparable peak in fewer rounds.
blocks.zh:
结果。 在64小时内,基地和基地+分析各完成15发,基地+分析+综合完成6发(图9,右面板).
单一药剂显示没有持续改善,而Base + analysis则产生持续上升的趋势,在第13轮达到64.8%.
加成合成每轮需要额外的运行时间,但到第六轮达到65.8%.
帮助指导转录到代码的结构:多剂分析将食谱提升到单剂上方,合成在更少的回合中达到可比较的峰值.

blocks.en: 6 Related Work
blocks.zh: 6 相关工作

blocks.en:
Data selection and synthesis for post-training. Early works show that curation matters more than scale: a small, well-chosen set can match or outperform a much larger one [ Zhou et al., 2023a , Muennighoff et al., 2025 ] , and data ordering alone shapes generalization [ He et al., 2025a ] .
Selection methods prune or reweight examples by information gain or diversity [ Agarwal et al., 2025 , Chen et al., 2025 ] .
Synthesis methods bootstrap instructions from seed sets, evolve complexity, or extract alignment data from aligned models [ Wang et al., 2023 , Xu et al., 2024a , Xu et al., 2024b , Mitra et al., 2024 , Ren et al., 2026 ] .
Some data curation methods also optimize specifically for preference data, curating feedback or preference training pairs [ Cui et al., 2024 , He et al., 2025b , Deng et al., 2025 ] .
All produce a fixed dataset without closing the loop on downstream training performance.
blocks.zh:
数据选择和综合用于培训后. 早期的作品显示,修饰的重要性大于规模:一个小而精选的套装可以匹配或超越一个大得多的套装[周等,2023a;慕能尼格罗夫等,2025],而光是订购的数据就能塑造通论[他等,2025a].
通过信息收益或多样性进行选择方法prune或再加权的例子[Agarwal等,2025年;Chen等,2025年]。
合成方法 从种子集得到的靴子说明,进化复杂度,或从对等模型中提取对等数据[王等,2023年;徐等,2024年a;徐等,2024年b;米特拉等,2024年;任等,2026年].
一些数据校正方法还专门优化了偏好数据,处理反馈或偏好培训对[Cui等人,2024年;He等人,2025年b;Deng等人,2025年].
全部制作一个固定数据集,而不关闭下游培训业绩的回路。

blocks.en:
Automated data optimization. A growing body of work attempts to automate data research, closing the loop between data curation and model training.
PostTrainBench [ Rank et al., 2026 ] audits 84 agent runs and finds that almost all converge on SFT with data as the sole search object.
On the selection side, TREX [ Ma et al., 2026 ] searches recipes via MCTS, AutoSelection [ Wu et al., 2026 ] formalizes operator-program search over a fixed pool, DataChef [ Chen et al., 2026b ] trains a policy with a proxy reward, and Luo et al. [2026] iterates on data alone with gains that plateau after round 8–15.
On the synthesis side, Autodata [ Kulikov et al., 2026 ] revises generation strategies from solver feedback, ANDES [ Zhao et al., 2026 ] packages synthesis as a callable skill, and BigBang [ The Endless Frontier Team, 2026 ] scales self-evolving synthesis with a critic proxy.
Arbor [ Jin et al., 2026 ] , AutoSOTA [ Li et al., 2026 ] , and the Anthropic automated researcher [ Wen et al., 2026 ] organize research with hypothesis trees, multi-agent decomposition, and diverse initial directions respectively.
These systems address either selection or synthesis, while we unify both and retrain from base each round so that every action is individually attributable.
blocks.zh:
自动化数据优化. 越来越多的工作试图使数据研究自动化,关闭数据整理与模型培训之间的循环.
PostTrain Bench [Rank et al., 2026] 审计84名特工运行,发现几乎所有特工都以数据为唯一搜索对象而聚合到SFT上.
在选择方面,TREX[Ma等,2026]通过MCTS搜索食谱,AutoSelection[Wu等,2026]将运营商-程序搜索正规化于一固定池上,DataChef [Chen等,2026b]以代理奖励的方式培训政策,而Luo等. [2026] 仅凭数据就以第8–15轮后高地的增益来计算.
在合成方面,Autodata[Kulikov等,2026]根据解析器反馈修改了生成策略,ANDES [Zhao等,2026]包合成作为一种可调用的技能,而BigBang[The Endless Frontier Team,2026]用评论家代理来缩放自演合成.
Arbor [Jin等,2026]; AutoSOTA [Li等,2026]; Anthropic自动化研究者 [Wen等,2026] 分别用假想树组织研究,多剂分解,并有多种初始方向.
这些系统既涉及选择,也涉及综合问题,而我们则将两者统一起来,并从每一回合的基础上进行再培训,以便每一项行动都由个人负责。

blocks.en:
Benchmarks for AI research. Benchmarks now evaluate agents on ML research tasks at scales from single Kaggle problems to full R&D pipelines [ Chan et al., 2025 , Huang et al., 2024 , Wijk et al., 2025 , Kon et al., 2026 , Zhang et al., 2025 , Lyu et al., 2026 , Garikaparthi et al., 2026 , Xu et al., 2026 ] , on AI infrastructure [ Ouyang et al., 2025 , Chi et al., 2026a , Φ-Bench contributors, 2026 , Yeon et al., 2026 ] , and on self-improvement [ Zhan et al., 2026 , Chi et al., 2026b , Chen et al., 2026a ] .
Closest to our setting, DataEnvGym [ Khan et al., 2025 ] frames data generation as an RL loop, Curation-Bench [ Kang et al., 2026 ] gives agents iterative control over a fixed pipeline, and RSIBench-Data [ Meng et al., 2026 ] and DataPrep-Bench [ Liang et al., 2026 ] benchmark data-centric recipe search.
We differ by requiring from-base retraining each round, repeated evaluation to bound noise, and a verification gate on synthesis.
blocks.zh:
AI研究的基准. 目前的基准评价了从单一卡格问题到完整的研发管道的ML研究任务的代理人[Chan等,2025年;Huang等,2024年;Wijk等,2025年;Kon等,2026年;Zhang等,2025年;Lyu等,2026年;Garikaparthi等,2026年;Xu等,2026年];AI基础设施[Oyang等,2025年;Chi等,2026年a;Q-Bench 撰稿人,2026年;Yeon等,2026年];以及自我改进[Zhan等,2026年;Chi等,2026b;Chen等,2026a]。
紧接我们的设置, DataEnvGym [Khan等, 2025] 帧数据生成为RL回路, Curation-Bench [Kang等, 2026] 给予代理对固定管线的迭接控制, RSI Bench-Data [Meng等, 2026] 和 DataPrep-Bench [Liang等, 2026] 基准数据中心食谱搜索.
我们的不同之处在于要求每轮从基地进行再培训,要求反复评估以约束噪音,并要求对合成进行核查。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
A single agent owning the full SFT data research loop collapses to one kind of change and loses context repeatedly.
AutoSFT adds structure that an executor separates execution from analysis, several analysis subagents propose complementary changes, and a synthesis subagent writes data for uncovered capabilities.
Adding each component one at a time under from-base retraining shows that the executor frees the meta agent’s context, analysis broadens changes and improves scores earlier, and synthesis reaches capabilities with almost no data in the pool.
The same loop transfers to coding without a ready-made taxonomy, where the system builds its own structure from the benchmark and pool alone.
These results suggest that the bottleneck may not be any single action but the structure that lets an agent cover the full range of data-engineer changes, and that multi-agent decomposition is a practical way to provide it.
blocks.zh:
一个拥有完整 SFT 数据研究回路的单一代理崩溃为一种变化并反复失去上下文.
AutoSFT会添加一个执行器将执行与分析分离的结构,几个分析子剂会提出互补的改变,一个合成子剂会为被发现的能力写出数据.
从基础再培训中一次添加每个组件,显示执行者释放元剂的上下文,分析拓宽了变化并提前提高分数,合成达到能力,而集合中几乎没有数据.
同样的循环转移到没有现成分类法的编码,系统从基准和池中单独建立自己的结构.
这些结果表明,瓶颈可能不是任何单一的动作,而是让一剂能够覆盖全部数据-引擎变化的结构,多剂分解是提供它的实际方法.

blocks.en: AI use statement
blocks.zh: AI 语句

blocks.en:
We used generative AI tools to edit prose for readability, to draft and refine figures, and to assist with code implementation for AutoSFT and the analysis scripts.
We did not use generative AI tools to generate research ideas, design the methodology, or produce any reported result.
The system under study is itself an LLM agent, so the data recipes, analysis, and synthesis prompts it produces are the object of our measurements rather than authored content of this paper.
All reported numbers come from the fixed training and evaluation script rather than from any agent’s self-report, and the authors verified every claim against the per-round run ledger.
We have reviewed all AI-assisted work and take responsibility for the final content of this paper.

blocks.en: Appendix B Details of AutoSFT implementation
blocks.zh: 附录B 自动SFT实施详情

blocks.en: B.1 Capability taxonomy
blocks.zh: B.1 能力分类学

blocks.en:
Deciding what data a round needs is easier when the benchmark already says what it is testing.
Instruction following does say so.
Its prompts carry constraints of known kinds, and a benchmark that groups them lets a weak group be read directly off the scores, after which the agent can raise that group’s share, label existing rows by the capability they teach, or ask for new rows aimed at it.
Most domains do not come with such a grouping, and we did not want a system that only works where one exists.
The meta agent therefore builds and maintains the grouping itself.
It starts from whatever structure the benchmark provides, which for instruction following is the published constraint types, and extends it as rounds expose distinctions the original grouping did not make.
When a benchmark provides nothing, the agent derives the groups from the failures it observes.
Every leaf of the resulting taxonomy is a requirement a program can decide, such as answering without using a comma, and carries the program that decides it.
Rows in the pool are labelled by the leaves they satisfy, which is what allows the meta agent to select data by capability rather than by source and gives the synthesis subagent stable names to write against.
The taxonomy is rebuilt for a new domain, and Section 5.4 reports how far that rebuilding got.
blocks.zh:
当基准已经表明测试内容时,决定一轮的数据需要多少就更容易了。
以下指示确实如此。
它的提示带有已知种类的制约,一个将它们分组的基准让一个弱小群体直接从分数中读出,然后代理者可以提高该群体的分数,用他们教授的能力给现有的行贴上标签,或者要求以它为目标的新行.
多数域不带这样的组合,我们不希望一个只存在于一个存在的地方的系统.
因此,元剂建立和维持组合本身。
它从基准提供的任何结构开始,对于以下的指令是已公布的制约类型,随着回合暴露出原始分组没有作出的区别而扩展。
基准一无所获时,代理商会从其观察到的故障中获取这些组别.
由此产生的分类学的每一个叶子都是一个程序可以决定的要求,比如不使用逗号来回答,并带有决定它的程序.
池中行由它们所满足的叶子所贴上标签,这就是使元剂能够根据能力而不是来源选择数据,并让合成子剂的稳定名来作对.

blocks.en: B.2 Memory
blocks.zh: B.2 记忆

blocks.en:
The history H < t H_{<t} of Section 2.1 is the only thing a from-base loop carries between rounds, and AutoSFT puts more in it than a list of recipes and scores.
Alongside those, it records the hypothesis a round registered before training, the verdict that hypothesis received, the lesson the verdict left, and the proposals the meta agent read but did not take.
Each entry is keyed by round, so a later round can read what an earlier one expected as well as what it got.
blocks.zh:
第2.1节的历史H < t H_{<t}是两回合之间唯一一个来自基线的环路所携带的东西,AutoSFT在其中所放的不仅仅是食谱和分数清单.
除了这些外,它还记录了在培训前登记的一回合假说、假设得到的判决、判决留下的教训以及元代理人宣读但未采纳的提议。
每个条目按圆键,所以后一轮可以读取一个更早的预期以及它得到的.

blocks.en:
Registering the hypothesis first is what makes it worth recording.
A round states the data change it plans, why that change should move the metric, the round its result will be compared against, the direction it expects, and the finer observation that would show the change working as intended.
The submission path refuses a round whose hypothesis was never written down.
A prediction written after the results are known can always be adjusted to fit them, which is what the ordering prevents.
blocks.zh:
先登记这个假说才值得记录
一回合说明它计划的数据变化,为什么这一变化应该移动度量衡,其结果将会被比较,它所期望的方向,以及能够显示变化如意的更细的观察.
呈文路径拒绝一个回合,其假设从未被写入.
已知结果后所写的预测总是可以进行调整以适应它们,这是命令所阻止的.

blocks.en:
A verdict is read on two separate questions.
The first asks what the benchmark mean did against the comparison round, judged only as a direction and only against the variation measured between repeated rounds.
The second asks whether the finer observation actually appeared in the evaluation outputs.
Keeping them apart matters because they can disagree, and a disagreement is informative.
A score that rose without its intended effect appearing has some other cause, and an effect that appeared without a score change means the slice it touched was too small or a loss elsewhere cancelled it.
blocks.zh:
对两个不同的问题宣读判决。
第一个问题是,与比较回合相比,基准的含义是什么? 比较回合仅被视为一个方向,仅与反复回合之间所衡量的差异相比。
第二个问题是,在评价产出中是否确实出现了更细的观察。
把他们分开,因为他们可以有分歧,分歧是信息。
一个没有出现预期效果而上升的分数有其他原因,一个没有改变分数而出现的效果意味着被它所触及的切片太小了,或者在别处丧失了它.

blocks.en:
What a verdict leaves behind is a short statement of what it means for later rounds.
A later round may disagree with an earlier statement by saying so in its own entry.
Nothing already written is edited: a registered prediction cannot be changed and a decided round is not re-judged, so the memory holds what the run believed at the time rather than a version tidied up afterwards.
blocks.zh:
判决所留下的是对以后各轮判决的简短陈述。
后一轮可能不同意先前的发言,在自己的条目中这样说。
任何已经写好的文字都未经编辑:一个已注册的预测无法被改变,一个决定的回合也没有被重新判断,所以记忆中保存着当时所相信的,而不是一个之后编织的版本.

blocks.en: B.4 Synthesis constraints and verification
blocks.zh: B.4 综合制约和核查

blocks.en:
Generation constraints. The subagent phrases each capability requirement without reproducing evaluation wording, and the generated rows pass an n n -gram overlap check against the evaluation sets before delivery, so a batch teaches the capability rather than the benchmark.
Rows must come from model API calls rather than from a script, which prevents a worker from assembling responses that satisfy the verifier without genuinely demonstrating the capability.
blocks.zh:
世代受限. 子代理短语在不复制评价用词的情况下对每个能力要求进行重复检查,生成的行在交付前通过n-克重置对照评价集的检查,因此一个批次会教授能力而不是基准.
行必须来自模型API的调用而不是脚本,这使得工人无法在不真正展示能力的情况下集合满足核查者的反应.

blocks.en:
Internal verification. The subagent attributes each evaluation subset’s requirements to an underlying capability, translates them into acceptance criteria, and builds a verifier for those criteria.
It then generates candidates, checks them against the verifier, and revises until they meet the criteria, maintaining both the criteria and the verifier as it goes so that omissions are corrected without changing the intended capability.
blocks.zh:
内部核查。 副代理人将每个评价子集的要求归结为基本能力,将其转化为接受标准,并为这些标准建立一个核查人。
然后,它产生候选人,对照核查员检查他们,并修改直至他们达到标准,同时保持标准和核查员,以便纠正遗漏而不改变预期能力。

blocks.en:
Target selection checks data supply rather than relying on aggregate capability scores alone. The subagent selects a target when the pool contains far fewer than the 1000 rows it treats as sufficient, and it records the count it finds.

A capability with a high aggregate score can therefore still be a target, because what is scarce is a specific constraint combination rather than the capability as a whole. An example is repetition together with a number word, as opposed to number words on their own.
The score of an exact combination cannot be measured directly, because the benchmark contains at most one question for it. The comparison in Figure 16 is therefore made at the aggregate capability level.

blocks.en: Appendix E Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录E 限制

blocks.en:
All results are obtained on one base model at one scale (Qwen3-1.7B-Base), so the effects we report may not hold at other scales, and a capability this model cannot learn from more data may be learnable by a larger one.
Each comparison runs one search per configuration, and although repeated evaluation bounds the noise of a single checkpoint, it does not bound the variation between independent searches.
Synthesis raises the aggregate score through a small number of learnable capabilities that the pool undersupplies, and it does not move capabilities the model cannot yet follow.
The generalization study covers a single new domain with short runs, so it demonstrates that the loop can transfer but does not establish how broadly.
blocks.zh:
所有结果都是在一个尺度(Qune3-1.7B-Base)的基准模型上取得的,因此我们所报告的效果可能不会在其他尺度上得到,这种模型无法从更多数据中学习的能力也许可以被更大的模型学习.
每个比较每个配置都运行一个搜索,虽然重复评价会约束单个检查点的噪音,但它并不约束独立搜索之间的差异.
合成通过少数池子所不足的可学习能力来提高总分,它不会移动模型尚无法遵循的能力.
通论研究涵盖一个有短跑的单一新域,因此表明循环可以转移,但并不确定其范围有多广.
